claims.claim_text: UL Solutions served more than 80,000 customers in over 110 countries in 2023, including approximately 60% of the Fortune 500 and Fortune's Global 500 companies, through its TIC and S&A businesses.
claims.subject: UL Solutions
claims.source_quote: In 2023, we served more than 80,000 customers in over 110 countries, including approximately 60% of the Fortune 500 and Fortune's Global 500 companies, through our TIC and S&A businesses.

claims.claim_text: The UL Mark is one of the most iconic safety symbols in the world; in 2023 the UL Mark was issued on billions of products globally and UL has science-based technical leadership in product safety testing.
claims.subject: UL Mark / UL Solutions IP
claims.source_quote: the UL Mark empowers trust in our customers products. In 2023, the UL Mark was issued on billions of products globally.

claims.claim_text: UL is a longstanding counterparty to large public companies; named megacaps disclose UL certification/testing relationships in their own SEC filings.

claims.claim_text: UL Solutions owns 70% of UL-CCIC, a joint venture with CCIC (a Chinese state-owned enterprise) that offers China Compulsory Certification (CCC) testing and product safety testing; Greater China generated $632M of 2023 revenue.
claims.subject: UL-CCIC joint venture
claims.object_value: $632M Greater China revenue 2023; 70% owned JV with CCIC
claims.source_quote: We, via our wholly owned affiliate UL LLC, own 70% of the issued and outstanding equity interests of UL-CCIC. The remaining 30% equity interest is owned by CCIC, a Chinese state-owned enterprise.

claims.claim_text: As of December 31, 2023, total long-term debt was $904 million ($300M 6.500% senior notes due 2028 plus Credit Facility); the company is profitable with $2,678M revenue and $368M segment operating income in 2023.
